name: Template designer
description: Website templates as data: rows of blocks with positions, colors, fonts and the views for tablet and phone, checked against limits that keep every template working and accessible. The same code builds the page in the designer and in the wiki.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Design templates
permissions.description: Create, copy, import and change website templates of data. Which template applies is still chosen with the settings of the site or of a category.

limits.label: Templates of data
limits.help: How many website templates of data the wiki keeps at most (also in the trash).

limits.label: Versions per template
limits.help: How many saved versions of a template are kept; older ones are removed when a new one is saved.

limits.label: Uploaded fonts
limits.help: How many fonts can be uploaded for templates at most.

limits.label: Size of a font file
limits.help: How large one uploaded font file (WOFF2) may be.

limits.label: Size of a font upload
limits.help: How large the request that uploads a font may be (the file as base64, about a third more than the file). Keep it above the size of a font file.
